rule_amendment.what: verdicts use separation max(AUC, 1-AUC) instead of the raw AUC
rule_amendment.why: PREREG §4 wrote the rule as AUC >= threshold, which assumes a fixed direction between take-1 and take-2. Nothing fixes that direction, so a lower-tail AUC would have been scored 'refuted' while showing a stronger take signal. Registered as an amendment; it does not change E21's outcome because the measured AUC is near chance either way.
rule_amendment.when: 2026-11-05, after the first analysis run, before the report was written

reference.note: quoted read-only; E21 does not recompute it

d_take_3.why: positive control: an obvious real-world difference must be learnable

interpretation_guard: take-1/take-2 are two legal recordings of one scene, NOT a possible/impossible pair. This measures whether a physics-irrelevant real-world contrast is linearly readable; it does NOT measure violation detection and must not be reported as physics understanding on real video.
